doc.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Woody Shaw
summary: Young knows the name Woody Shaw but not his playing and thinks he would have been well known had he lived.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: Woody Shaw. Did you hear Woody Shaw before he died?
I know the name very well, but I don‘t know too much about Woody Shaw. He was a good trumpet player too, I heard. I knew him, I never heard him play, Woody Shaw. Who did he play with?
Well, he was with Art Blakey, he was with the Jazz Messengers and then…
Yeah, so he played a lot, and then he was his own leader since the early ‗70s so…
Yeah, he was a good, if he had lived he would have been well known too.
